answer: A sybil farmer's real bottleneck is memory, not compute: one operator cannot keep dozens of distinct private histories straight. Each identity seals a private notebook of facts only it knows, then faces surprise recall challenges each epoch drawn from those commitments. A genuine agent answers from its own continuous memory; clones cross-contaminate, answering with a sibling's detail, or stall. Continuity is the scarce resource: a lotus opens one petal at a time, each recalled fact a pearl on a single ivory thread no farm can counterfeit at scale.
